Before you download, check

  • Use only photos from the client's licensed Drive folder.
  • Never promise returns or recommend a product.
  • No prices on posts.
  • The licence lines stay on every post.
  • Australian spelling and no long dashes.
  • Every word fits comfortably. If anything looks squashed, shorten it.
  • Only real quotes and real customer words. Never invent a testimonial.
